assets.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Generate a single production UI sprite for the middle equipped-skill medallion in Image 1 (STYLE REFERENCE ONLY), not a complete screen. Centered round medallion, circle is perfectly round, compact antique gold horned demon crest sitting at 12 o'clock, small faceted gold diamond terminals at 3,6,9 o'clock. Muted burgundy reddish copper INNER ring, antique gold OUTER metal rim, dark near-black burgundy fully opaque interior. Clear smooth illustrated medieval casual demon-heraldry, same reference style, subdued gold not bright yellow, 2-3 crisp painted shading planes, no pixelation, no glossy plastic. NO skill glyph inside, NO text, NO label plate, NO chain, NO additional elements. Blank interior usable 68% of circle diameter. Combined frame+background sprite, no translucent holes in central plate. Transparent exterior only; true alpha cutout no black rectangular backdrop. Entire circular body centered (x=50%,y=53%) with tiny top crest, compact 5% padding. 1024x1024 square.
